description: Verified period-specific imagery for NZ GIS History timeline, based on original maps, archive photographs and post-earthquake orthophotography.

items.commonsTitle: File:Seismic hazard map around epicentre of 2010 Canterbury earthquake.jpg
items.title: Seismic hazard around the 2010 Canterbury earthquake epicentre
items.credit: Global Seismic Hazard Assessment Program, United States Geological Survey; public-domain federal government map.
items.altText: Seismic hazard map of the central South Island around the epicentre of the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake.
items.caption: USGS/GSHAP hazard map showing estimated peak ground acceleration with a ten per cent probability of exceedance over fifty years, for the region around the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake. This is a hazard forecast, not a measured shaking map or the emergency response Common Operating Picture.
items.context: Original USGS hazard map associated with the 2010 Darfield earthquake. It illustrates background seismic risk geography rather than observed ground shaking or Jithen Singh's earthquake response GIS.

items.title: Greendale Fault surface displacement after the 2010 Canterbury earthquake
items.credit: Brendan Zim; Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 Generic, from Wikimedia Commons. WebP derivatives resized without cropping.
items.altText: Contemporaneous ground photograph of lateral surface displacement along the Greendale Fault caused by the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake.
items.caption: Brendan Zim photograph of ground rupture and displacement along the Greendale Fault on 4 September 2010. The physical damage shows the event measured and mapped by field teams.
items.context: A dated original photograph of the September 2010 earthquake's physical impact. The image does not show a response mapping application or prove a named agency's GIS use.

items.commonsTitle: File:Cashmere High School aerial photo, 24 Feb 2011.jpg
items.sourceName: Wikimedia Commons / LINZ post-earthquake aerial survey
items.title: LINZ Christchurch earthquake-response aerial orthophotography, 24 February 2011
items.credit: New Zealand Aerial Mapping for the Christchurch Response Centre, from LINZ post-earthquake aerial photography. CC BY 3.0 New Zealand.
items.altText: High-resolution aerial orthophoto of Cashmere High School and nearby Christchurch landscape captured after the February 2011 earthquake.
items.caption: New Zealand Aerial Mapping orthophotography of the Cashmere High School area, captured 24 February 2011 for the Christchurch Response Centre, with earthquake-related liquefaction visible on the school playing fields.
items.context: Genuine disaster-response orthophotography captured two days after the 22 February 2011 Christchurch earthquake. It is an operational imagery product, not a screenshot from the Common Operating Picture.
